set.body: ScalaFIM is unreleased and must not carry deprecated aliases or historical API naming. Delete the central latent archive codec facade; expose factual representation-specific codecs; recognize LNA formats through an explicitly supplied immutable duplicate-rejecting registry; name the current LNA pipeline, HDF5 family, and manifest adapter by format and behavior; rename the dataset response adapter and adapter failure factually; preserve the frozen corpus strictly as numerical regression evidence. Acceptance: no historical-named response/archive production API or forwarding alias remains; LNA 2 handling is explicit; dataset LNA opening requires registry policy; JVM and Scala.js suites, boundary guards, the frozen corpus, compileAll, and testAll pass; unrelated work is preserved.
set.title: Remove pre-release response/archive shims and central dispatch
